name: OKCreature
source:
Online dating is hard enough without adding real monsters to the mix. A fun swipe through a dating app where the matches aren't all quite what they seem.

[From [url=https://ghostclown.itch.io/okcreature]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
网上约会已经够难了，更别说还要面对真正的怪物。这是一款轻松有趣的交友应用滑卡游戏，但那些配对对象似乎并不像表面看起来那么简单。

[来源：[url=https://ghostclown.itch.io/okcreature]Itch.io[/url]]
